subject: general
question: “World Refugee Day” is observed every year on ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**20th June.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **World Refugee Day:-**

 
 
• It is an international observance held annually on June 20th.
 
• It is a day designated by the United Nations to honor the courage, resilience, and strength of millions of refugees worldwide who have been forced to flee their homes due to conflict, persecution, or other forms of violence.
 
• The main purpose of World Refugee Day is to raise awareness about the plight of refugees and to mobilize support for their protection and well-being.
 
• It serves as a reminder that refugees are ordinary people who have been through extraordinary circumstances and deserve compassion, empathy, and assistance.
 
• The theme for World Refugee Day may vary each year, focusing on different aspects of the refugee crisis. It serves as a platform to shed light.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Important days in June:-**

 
 
• June 1:- Global Day of Parents
 
• June 5:- World Environment Day
 
• June 8:- World Oceans Day
 
• June 14:- World Blood Donor Day
 
• June 17:- World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought
 
• June 19:- Juneteenth
 
• June 20:- World Refugee Day
 
• June 21:- International Day of Yoga
 
• June 23:- United Nations Public Service Day
 
• June 26:- International Day against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking
 
• June 30:- International Asteroid Day
